sections.title: Short Bio
sections.tex:
Emanuele Bajo is Full Professor of Finance at the University of Bologna and Director of the Master in Finance and Honorary Professor at the University of Queensland (Australia).

His research spans IPOs and capital markets, household finance and financial literacy, behavioral finance, corporate risk management, and the role of information and governance structures in financial markets. He has published extensively in leading international journals, including the \textit{Journal of Financial Economics}, the \textit{Journal of Corporate Finance}, and the \textit{Journal of Banking and Finance}. 

He serves as Executive Editor of the \textit{Journal of Economics and Business} and is a member of the Consultative Working Group of the Risk Standing Committee of the European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA).

He has held visiting appointments at the University of Queensland, Johns Hopkins University, San Diego State University, and Boston College. Earlier in his career, he worked in business consulting and founded one of Italy’s first major financial websites.
